documents.title: OpenAI Evidence Summary
documents.summary: OpenAI fit, constraints, and initial recommendation.
documents.content:
# OpenAI Evidence Summary

OpenAI currently presents the strongest balance of capability, architecture fit, and practical integration flexibility for the compare workbench pilot.

- Strong overall capability
- Good hosted integration fit
- Requires governance and controls review for sovereignty-sensitive workloads

documents.title: Anthropic Evidence Summary
documents.summary: Anthropic as a strong secondary option.
documents.content:
# Anthropic Evidence Summary

Anthropic remains a credible option with strong model quality, but its enterprise fit should be assessed through supportability, controls, and procurement path.

- Strong model performance
- Good governance potential
- Needs clearer operational pathway

# Gemini Evidence Summary

Gemini may become more attractive where ecosystem alignment materially improves integration or supportability.

documents.title: GC LLM Evidence Summary

# GC LLM Evidence Summary

GC LLM aligns well with public-sector governance intent, but current departmental endpoint consumability should not be assumed without explicit confirmation.

- Strong governance alignment
- Strategic importance
- Current consumption model still needs validation

documents.title: Rubric Method
documents.summary: How to interpret the compare frame.
documents.content:
# Rubric Method

Gates come first. Composite score supports ranking, not automatic approval.

Architecture fit, governance pathway, and enterprise support model all matter.
